text:
ana: Heads-up — customer Orion asked for a per-route cost breakdown + tracing hooks for their Dedicated deployment by EOW. Can we triage? Quick context: they want cost per model/route, sampleable traces, and error spike alerts.

mike: Got it. What's the priority vs other console work? Are we aiming full dashboard or a lightweight export?

ana: Priority is high for that customer (enterprise deal), but we can scope to a minimum: 1) per-route token cost table, 2) trace sampling toggle + 'show recent spans', 3) error rate sparkline + basic alert rule. Incremental delivery ok.

sophia: Acceptance criteria proposal: - Route cost: per-hour and per-100k tokens, filterable by model/route/team; - Trace hooks: sampling control + quick span view; - Alerts: threshold + link-to-traces. RBAC + audit logs required.

jeff: Infra note — trace sampling has storage impact. If we do 2% sampling on their traffic, estimate ~50GB/week extra on traces backend. Need to budget or offer 'lite traces' (metadata-only). Also need to verify encryption/forwarding for Private deployments.

mike: Cheaper approach idea: pre-aggregate per-route costs hourly and surface estimates in the console; for traces, store span metadata (service, op, duration) and only fetch full span payload on demand.

sophia: UX plan: 2-phase delivery. Phase 1 (alpha, 2 sprints): cost table + sampling toggle + one-click recent spans for a route + simple alert. Phase 2: richer trace viewer, sampling analytics, historical cost breakdown. I'll mocklite screens.

ana: Customers also require: SLA for cost reporting latency (<5m), canary rollout plan, and rollback criteria. Sales asked for an outline to share tomorrow.

jeff: Canary/rollback suggestions: canary to 10% traffic, monitor trace ingestion backlog and cost delta. Rollback if trace backlog > 1h or reported cost differs from billing by >5% for 15m. Fallback mode should be 'aggregated-only' (no raw traces).

mike: Quick task list (alpha): 1) backend: cost aggregator with per-route tags + hourly rolls, 2) trace sampler flag + forwarder shim, 3) UI: cost table + sampling toggle + recent spans modal, 4) alerting rule wiring. Rough estimate: ~3 FTE-weeks for alpha. +1 :thumbsup:.

sophia: UX note — surface "estimated cost" inline on route list rows to reduce clicks. Also add a small tooltip explaining sampling vs full traces.

ana: Next steps: @mike spec API + schema by Mon, @sophia deliver 2 lightweight mocks by Tue, @jeff provide storage/cost calc by EOD. I will consolidate and send to sales.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-4532 for "Orion: per-route cost + traces (alpha)" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4532

mike: Will start draft PR for cost agg and stub API today.

ana: Thanks — will sync Wed 9am if needed.
